## Process Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Risk Categories | Establishes hierarchy, severity, and level of need |
| Field Screening | Screens and edits required fields |
| Verification | Verifies information from external sources |
| Scoring | Establishes severity scores and diagnoses |
| Service Association | Associates with applicable service needs |

## Constraints & Failures

- **Constraints**: States have different screening requirements and health benefits. Agencies may not coordinate to share information. Potential inter-agency conflicts over health care information use.
- **Potential Failure**: Care Manager unable to acquire history and/or examination information
